jei.ohnomoremeteors.info.cindrite_repair: Cindrite gear is repaired in a furnace, not an anvil. Put the damaged item in the top slot and heat fuel below: each fuel item the furnace uses up gives back some durability. Coal and charcoal give a little; magma, blaze powder and blaze rods more; a coal block or lava bucket the most. Wood and other plain fuels burn but repair nothing. The output slot must be empty or hold Cindrite nuggets.
jei.ohnomoremeteors.info.rimerite_repair: Rimerite gear is repaired in a Frostery, not an anvil. Put the damaged item in the top slot and cold fuel below: each fuel item used up gives back some durability. Snowballs give a little; ice and raw Rimerite more; packed and blue ice the most. The output slot must be empty or hold Rimerite nuggets.
jei.ohnomoremeteors.info.frostery: The Frostery is a cold furnace. It burns only cold fuel (snow, ice, packed and blue ice, Rimerite); ordinary furnace fuel does nothing in it. It freezes items (see its recipe tab) and repairs Rimerite gear. Buckets used in a recipe are given back empty.
